import hashlib,json,os,shutil,statistics,subprocess,tempfile,time
from pathlib import Path
os.sched_setaffinity(0,{0})
binaries={k:str(Path(v).resolve()) for k,v in {'parent':'build/review-j17-lock-final/release/mus-solver','candidate':'build/review-j08-final2/release/mus-solver'}.items()}
def digest(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def policies(p):return {f.name:digest(f) for f in p.iterdir() if f.name=='values.txt' or f.name.endswith('.cfr.zst')}
data={'parent_commit':'14bbd70','method':'Three alternating pairs on CPU0 and workspace Btrfs. Same interrupted table with 36 published cells and 8 completed cells of the last 9-cell diagonal; 1000 iterations/10000 samples, seed7. Candidate validates and recovers the 8 checkpoints; parent retrains all 9. Compare every final checkpoint and value and check mtime preservation for recovered cells.','runs':[]}
output=Path('/tmp/mus-review-j08-resume-performance.json')
def save():output.write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2)+'\n')
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='recovery-resume-',dir=str(Path('build/review-j17-sync-io').resolve())) as tmp:
 root=Path(tmp);base=root/'interrupted';base.mkdir()
 (base/'score-39-31.cfr.zst').mkdir()
 def command(version,directory):return [binaries[version],'--format','ordago-score','--score','35:35','--iterations','1000','--evaluation-samples','10000','--seed','7','--continuation',str(directory)]
 p=subprocess.run(command('candidate',base),capture_output=True,text=True)
 assert p.returncode!=0 and 'score-cell score=38:32' in p.stdout
 (base/'score-39-31.cfr.zst').rmdir()
 initial=policies(base);assert len(initial)==45
 provisional=[f'score-{a:02d}-{70-a:02d}.cfr.zst' for a in range(31,39)]
 data['journal_bytes']= (base/'recovery.txt').stat().st_size
 reference=None
 for repeat in range(3):
  for version in (['parent','candidate'] if repeat%2==0 else ['candidate','parent']):
   directory=root/f'{version}-{repeat}';shutil.copytree(base,directory)
   before={name:(directory/name).stat().st_mtime_ns for name in provisional}
   args=command(version,directory)
   with tempfile.TemporaryFile(mode='w+') as log:
    start=time.perf_counter();pid=os.posix_spawn(args[0],args,os.environ,file_actions=[(os.POSIX_SPAWN_DUP2,log.fileno(),1),(os.POSIX_SPAWN_DUP2,log.fileno(),2)])
    _,status,usage=os.wait4(pid,0);elapsed=time.perf_counter()-start;log.seek(0);stdout=log.read()
   assert status==0,stdout
   h=policies(directory);assert len(h)==46
   if reference is None:reference=h
   assert h==reference
   preserved=sum((directory/name).stat().st_mtime_ns==before[name] for name in provisional)
   assert preserved==(8 if version=='candidate' else 0)
   assert stdout.count('score-recovered')==(8 if version=='candidate' else 0)
   row={'version':version,'repeat':repeat+1,'wall_seconds':elapsed,'peak_rss_kib':usage.ru_maxrss,'preserved_checkpoints':preserved,'all_files_identical':True,'command':args,'stdout':stdout}
   data['runs'].append(row);save();print(version,repeat+1,elapsed,usage.ru_maxrss,flush=True)
 data['summary']={}
 for metric in ['wall_seconds','peak_rss_kib']:
  a=statistics.median(r[metric] for r in data['runs'] if r['version']=='parent');b=statistics.median(r[metric] for r in data['runs'] if r['version']=='candidate')
  data['summary'][metric]={'parent':a,'candidate':b,'change_percent':100*(b/a-1)}
 data['file_sha256']=reference;save();print(json.dumps(data['summary']),flush=True)
